covariance.availability: These selected primary tables provide marginal uncertainties, not a cross-edition joint covariance for the two comparison ratios. No zero covariance or joint likelihood is assumed.

electron_MeV.role: reference denominator and optional calibrated energy display only

muon_electron_ratio.role: comparison only; published direct ratio includes its adjustment uncertainty

lepton_cycle/experimental_inputs.json.selection: Frozen CODATA 2022 direct muon/electron ratio and electron energy; PDG 2024 tau average. Retrospective comparison, not a prospective test.

tau_MeV.edition: S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024)

openwave_axial_state/inputs.json.ancestry: The axial datum selects the native split-site state through U. It is a calibration input, not a held-out prediction. No effective current factor is fitted.

axial_source.location: Page 11, neutron decay parameters, lambda = g_A/g_V
axial_source.role: Fourth empirical calibration input selecting U and the native baryon state.
axial_source.sign_convention: PDG lists lambda=-1.2753. Compare its magnitude with the positive native Pauli-current reduced coefficient.

openwave_axial_state/inputs.json.colour_edge_choice: Positive native edge-colour Casimir with coefficient1; an explicit architecture control of disconnected-copy coloured thresholds. It is identically zero on every two-cell global singlet, including spatially separated q+diquark states, and supplies no two-cell spatial binding or continuum confinement proof.

inherited_mass_input_ancestry.uncertainty_scope: Central values only. Hadron targets calibrate three action coefficients and are not independent predictions. Comparison values neither fix those coefficients nor establish a physical species dictionary.

openwave_neutrino_calibration/oscillatio.dataset: NuFIT 6.0, IC24 with SK atmospheric data, normal ordering, table 1
openwave_neutrino_calibration/oscillatio.input_role: Six empirical oscillation parameters calibrate the declared neutral family tensor. Reproducing those parameters is not an independent prediction. Normal ordering and the lightest mass are declared member choices.

scope: Empirical calibration inputs retained with the specified matter coefficients. Their fitted agreement is not an independent transport prediction.
